contract.posterior: fresh joint refit of original 18S hierarchy plus sex outcomes
contract.primary_deletion: all sex-assay rows of one participant removed jointly; that participant's 18S remains conditioned upon
contract.weighting: row mean within participant/sex, then sex equal, then participant equal
contract.nondetection: exactly one only; quantified positives below one remain positive
contract.warning: PSIS is not an exact refit; groups above the sample-size-dependent good-k threshold require masked sex_include=0 refits

delay_zero_replay.reason: delay-zero Cao nesting check applies only to C0
